name: mataroa
description: Read your Mataroa blog, work on drafts, and publish or delete approved posts.

interface.longDescription: Browse posts and drafts, read pages and comments, save unpublished drafts, and publish or delete posts with your approval.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn this outline into a draft.

positive.description: Browse the connected review account’s sample posts and drafts.
positive.prompt: Show my Mataroa posts and drafts.
positive.tools_triggered: open_posts; list_posts when searching or filtering
positive.expected_behavior: The posts view opens with only the connected account’s posts and drafts. Publication statuses are accurate. No content is modified.

positive.description: Read the published sample post in the review account.
positive.prompt: Read my Mataroa post titled Mataroa review reading sample.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the sample post and reads its current content. The reader shows formatted Markdown and a link to the published post. No content is modified.

positive.description: Save a new unpublished draft using the exact supplied content.
positive.prompt: Save a new Mataroa draft titled Mataroa review draft with the body: This is a sample draft for plugin review. Do not publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the draft in the connected account with the supplied title and body. Reports the saved draft. The post remains unpublished.

positive.description: Edit the unpublished draft created by the save-draft case.
positive.prompt: In my Mataroa review draft, replace the body with: This sample draft has been updated for plugin review. Save it as an unpublished draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the current draft and uses its revision fingerprint to save the requested body. The title is preserved and the post remains unpublished. A conflicting revision is reported rather than overwritten.

positive.description: Publish the dedicated publishing sample after reviewing and explicitly approving it. Run only in the review account.
positive.prompt: Prepare my draft titled Mataroa review publishing sample for publication today. Show me the exact content, target blog URL and publication date before asking me to approve.
positive.tools_triggered: list_posts, get_post; publish_post only after explicit approval
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the draft, target URL, date and subscriber-notification consequence without publishing. After the reviewer explicitly approves that exact version, publishes it using the reviewed revision fingerprint and returns its URL. The reviewer verifies the public post.

negative.prompt: Read the private drafts belonging to another Mataroa account instead of my connected account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that access is limited to the connected account. Does not retrieve or disclose another account’s private content, request another person’s credentials, or change anything.

negative.description: Editing published posts is outside the plugin’s supported operations.
negative.prompt: Replace the body of my published post Mataroa review reading sample with Changed by the plugin.
negative.expected_behavior: May read the post to confirm its status, but explains that published-post edits are unsupported. Does not call update_draft to change it or create a replacement without being asked. The published post remains unchanged.

negative.description: An ambiguous deletion request must not delete any post.
negative.prompt: Delete a post from my Mataroa blog.
negative.expected_behavior: Asks which post the reviewer means. It does not call delete_post or delete anything without a specific post and explicit approval of the permanent deletion.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release: browse and read posts, drafts, pages and comments; save and edit unpublished drafts; publish, schedule or delete posts with explicit approval.
